scope: N=2 MAX; continuous USB read; FULL; configured 200 Hz
condition_basis: User explicitly clarified these four temperature groups are full load, then requested recording both voltage and current. FULL/rate/host condition follows the ongoing Power series; DMM photos do not independently verify firmware or actual rate.
load_definition_note: MAX/full load is user confirmed. No mass, distribution or contact area was supplied for these four new configurations; do not copy the 2000 g value from older MAX YAMLs.
readings_source: 20 photographs: 8 DC mA and 12 DC V photos, each visually transcribed for main, MIN and MAX.
module_mapping_basis: Ascending physical module-ID measurement order established by user; assign module current and module voltage photographs separately in timestamp order.
source_voltage_mapping_basis: The first voltage photograph within each combination is assigned SOURCE following the established capture convention. The probe endpoint is not visible in these DMM photographs; this label is inferred rather than independently verified by the image.
temperature_source: User message in this conversation, explicitly clarified as full load (MAX).
temperature_order: Two module STM32 points in ascending module ID, Teensy, regulator
temperature_transcription_note: The M1-M3 regulator value supplied as 29,2 is recorded as 29.2 degC.
display_precision_note: M1-M2 M1 main current is displayed as 19.99 mA; M1-M3 M1 as 20.32 mA. CSV preserves the photographed decimal precision. Formatting or arithmetic must not imply extra measured digits.
measurement_meaning: Main DMM readings are representative, not verified time averages. MIN/MAX are display extrema, not standard deviations or verified instantaneous peaks. Both types of measurement are recorded, but this does not mean simultaneous voltage/current acquisition.
counting: Four additional MAX configurations, each with one observation per branch; no independent same-condition repetitions added.
power_estimate: P_source_output_estimate_mW = V_source_main_V times sum of sequential branch main currents in mA. Source and module voltages and currents are acquired sequentially. Estimate excludes USB-powered Teensy and regulator losses.
known_limitations: The four new configurations are user-confirmed MAX; exact applied mass, distribution and area remain unspecified, limiting quantitative comparisons with older MAX observations.
Original two N=2 MAX configurations are from the 2026-09-05 filename-date batch; the new four are from 2026-09-07. Batch and combination effects cannot be separated from single records.
ZERO/MAX differences are descriptive comparisons of matching physical combinations, not repeated paired trials; old/new dates and load definitions limit causal attribution.
Temperatures are point readings without verified ambient temperature or settling time. Startup peaks, ripple, load-switching waveforms and continuous thermal curves remain future work as requested.
No fault-count or session-integrity evidence is inferred from these photographs. Published main 2.1, frozen analysis_v2_1 and prior ZERO data remain unchanged.
